integrity: All finite-size identities have exact symbolic proofs. Exact rational computational checks supplement, but do not replace, the all-N proofs. Asymptotic constants are obtained by Stirling and discrete Laplace expansion; numerical checks only support reproducibility. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete homogeneous hypergraph; synchronous or sparse-network updates, changing group size with \(N\), growing initial positive count, noisy or biased opinion rules, and consensus-time laws are excluded. The fixed-degree asymptotic must not be extrapolated to \(d=N-1\).
title: Exact minority-fixation barrier in the quadratic hypergraph voter model
